spec.title: Total cost
spec.description: Total cost over the selected time range

spec.title: Active sessions
spec.description: Unique sessions with activity in the selected time range

spec.title: Lines of code over time (added vs removed)
spec.description: Cumulative lines added and removed by Claude Code across all users.

spec.title: Lines added — by user
spec.description: Lines of code added per user over the selected time range.

spec.title: Commits over time (by user)
spec.description: Commits attributed to Claude Code sessions per user over time.

spec.title: Total tokens
spec.description: Total tokens consumed over the selected time range

spec.title: Cost by agent
spec.description: How cost is distributed across different agent types (main, subagent, custom).

spec.title: Cost by skill
spec.description: Cost breakdown by skill/task type, showing which workflows drive the most spend.

spec.title: Tokens by agent
spec.description: Token consumption split across agent types.

spec.title: Cost by MCP server
spec.description: Cost driven by each MCP server integration. Useful for identifying expensive tool calls.

spec.title: Session start type (fresh vs resume)
spec.description: Share of sessions that are fresh starts vs resumptions of previous sessions.

spec.title: Active users
spec.description: Users with at least one session in the selected time range

spec.title: Code edit decisions
spec.description: Share of code edit decisions that were accepted vs rejected by the user.

spec.title: Cache-read ratio by user (total)
spec.description: Cache-read tokens as % of total tokens per user over the selected time range. Higher = more efficient (fewer billed tokens).

spec.title: Lines edited over time (by user)
spec.description: Lines added + removed per user over time.

spec.title: Cache-read ratio
spec.description: Cache-read tokens as a share of all tokens in the selected time range

spec.title: Lines edited by user (total)
spec.description: Total lines added + removed per user over the selected time range.

spec.title: Tokens vs Lines per User
spec.description: Scatter: each dot = one user. Right = more tokens; up = more lines. Top-left is most efficient.

spec.expression: SELECT CASE WHEN A.user_email = 'i@dasch.swiss' THEN 'ivan' ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(REPLACE(A.user_email, '@dasch.swiss', ''), '.', 1) END AS user_email, A.__value__ AS tokens, B.__value__ AS loc FROM A JOIN B ON A.user_email = B.user_email LIMIT 100

spec.title: Token Efficiency per User
spec.description: Thousands of tokens used per line of code. Lower = more efficient. Users with fewer than 100 lines are excluded to avoid outliers.

spec.expr: sort(((label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by(user_email)(increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total[$__range])), "user_email", "$1", "user_email", "([^@]+)@dasch.swiss"), "user_email", "ivan", "user_email", "^i$"), "user_email", "$1", "user_email", "([^.]+)\\.(.+)") / (1000 * clamp_min(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by(user_email)(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total[$__range])), "user_email", "$1", "user_email", "([^@]+)@dasch.swiss"), "user_email", "ivan", "user_email", "^i$"), "user_email", "$1", "user_email", "([^.]+)\\.(.+)"), 1))) and on(user_email) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by(user_email)(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total[$__range])), "user_email", "$1", "user_email", "([^@]+)@dasch.swiss"), "user_email", "ivan", "user_email", "^i$"), "user_email", "$1", "user_email", "([^.]+)\\.(.+)") >= 100)) or label_replace(avg((sum by(user_email)(increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total[$__range])) / (1000 * clamp_min(sum by(user_email)(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total[$__range])), 1))) and on(user_email) (sum by(user_email)(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total[$__range])) >= 100)), "user_email", "⌀ Average", "", ""))
